name: mindflayer-keypad
description: Release tooling for Mind Flayer keypad firmware

scripts.format: npm run format:cpp && npm run format:docs
scripts.format:check: npm run format:cpp:check && npm run format:docs:check
scripts.format:cpp: clang-format -i src/*.cpp src/*.h include/*.h lib/*/*.cpp lib/*/*.h test/*/*.cpp test/host/*.h test/host/application/*.h scripts/*.h
scripts.format:cpp:check: clang-format --dry-run --Werror src/*.cpp src/*.h include/*.h lib/*/*.cpp lib/*/*.h test/*/*.cpp test/host/*.h test/host/application/*.h scripts/*.h
